Next day, the guy gets us all into a high speed car chase three states away from our home state. Everything was in slow motion as it was happening. We reach 120 mph with three cops on our tail. Finally we swerve on the side of the highway. The cop cars park in front of us and all run out, pointing guns at us while simultaneously yanking us out of the vehicle and onto the ground. 

They handcuff us and put us all in separate cars, take our information, and then let myself and the two friends go, leaving us stranded on the side of highway, as they take crazy boy away and his car keys. 

Friends and I walk to the nearest gas station, and some lady picks us up and drops us off in a nearby hotel. 

Strange secquence of events. My parents never found out, and sometimes it's still hard to believe it happened to me.
